2. The petitioners as pre-emptors filed a case under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1951 in the Court of the Assistant Judge, Bauphal being Miscellaneous Case No. 66 of 1984, alleging inter alia that Abul Hossain and Ful Bibi were the owners of the case land. After the death of Ful Bibi her heirs opposite party Nos. 2-6 succeeded her and eventually they sold the case land measuring 1.39½ acres to the pre-emptee by a registered kabala dated 21-10-1975 at a consideration of Tk. 5520.00 only. It was further contended that no notice under section 89 of the SAT Act was served upon the pre-emptors' father Abul Hossain, who was alive at the relevant time. Ii was further alleged that opposite party No.1 did not possess the case land following  the execution and registration of the kabala in question and the petitioners for the first time came to the learn about the impugned kabala on 28-2-84 from one Mostafa Howlader and others. The petitioners are co-sharers in the case jote and as such they are entitled to pre-emption. 

 7. I have gone through the judgments of the Courts below and heard the learned Advocates of the contending parties at length. It appears that the learned trial Court on detailed discussion of the evidence of 3 witnesses of the pre-emptor partners and the evidence of 2 witnesses of the contesting opposite party came to a clear finding that notice of the impugned sale was duly served upon Abul Hossain, father of the pre-emptor-petitioners, and the petitioners and their father have had complete knowledge about the disputed sale and, as such, this pre-emption application filed after 8 years of the impugned kabala is hopelessly barred by limitation. The learned trial Court disbelieved the story of the petitioners' alleged knowledge of the impugned kabala for the first time on 28-2-1984. The petitioner’s witnesses at the trial on the question of their knowledge of the impugned kabala are PW 2 Golam Mustafa and PW 3 Abdul Karim. The learned trial Court found that in the pre-emption application the petitioners clearly stated that 4 persons were present when for the first time they came to learn about the impugned kabala on 28-2-1984. PW 1 stated in his evidence that only PW 2 Golam Mostafa and PW 3 Abdul Karim were present at that time. He omitted the names of Salim and Abdul Hye. Petitioners witness No.2 Golam Mostafa and witness No.3 Abdul Karim also did not name Salim and Abdul Hye, who were also present at the time of disclosing to the pre-emptors about the impugned kabala.
